title: SIH26153 feature schema and inference contract
description: Deliverable R3. Generated by ai/feature_engineering/build_feature_schema_contract.py from ai/inference/contract.py; do not edit by hand.

RawFlow.title: RawFlow
RawFlow.description: One normalised network flow as stored in raw_flows and as produced by the CSV/CICIDS2017 ingestion path.

flags.description: Comma-separated TCP flags seen in the flow, or NONE.

failed_conn_info.description: TCP connection health; NA for non-TCP.

label.description: Ground-truth label when the source is a labelled dataset.

TrafficWindow.title: TrafficWindow
TrafficWindow.description: Metadata for one observation window W(t) = [window_start, window_end).

WindowFeatures.title: WindowFeatures
WindowFeatures.description: Feature vector x_t for one window, schema v1. All 37 features are required; no extras.

packet_count.description: Sum of packets over all flows.

byte_count.description: Sum of bytes over all flows.

packet_length_std.description: Std. dev. of per-flow mean packet size.

src_ip_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of source IP distribution over flows.

dst_port_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of destination port distribution over flows.

syn_ack_ratio.description: SYN flows / (ACK flows + 1). Handshake asymmetry; ~1.0 is healthy.

failed_conn_ratio.description: Flows with failed_conn_info in {SYN_NO_ACK, RST_ABORT, ZERO_WIN} / flow_count.

inbound_outbound_ratio.description: Flows into the monitored subnet / (flows out + 1).

retry_rate.description: Flows repeating an earlier (src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) in the window / flow_count.

syn_burst_score.description: SYN flows / (mean SYN flows of previous 3 windows + 1).

contribution.description: Signed share of the risk attributed to this feature (SHAP value or normalised rule weight).

InferenceRequest.title: InferenceRequest
InferenceRequest.description: Backend -> model call for one window. Python: ai.inference.forecast(request).

timestamp.description: window_end of the observation window (the forecast epoch t).

previous_windows.description: Optional: up to 3 preceding feature vectors, oldest first, for sequence-aware models.

InferenceResponse.title: InferenceResponse
InferenceResponse.description: Model -> backend result for one window. Persisted into predictions; alerts are derived from it.

timestamp.description: Forecast epoch t; the forecast covers (t, t + forecast_horizon_sec].

predicted_attack_type.description: BENIGN when no attack is forecast; UNKNOWN when out-of-distribution.

is_ood.description: Feature vector is outside the training envelope.

windowing_parameters.description: Sliding-window profiles. Training uses the macro profile with a 10 s stride; the backend MVP materialises fixed (stride = window) 60 s windows and will move to the 10 s stride in the strong version.
windowing_parameters.label_rule: y_t = 1 if any flow with label != BENIGN starts in (t, t + forecast_horizon_sec]; the observation window itself is never used for the label.

anti_leakage_invariants.split_rule: Chronological train/validation/test split; drop every window whose forecast horizon crosses a split boundary (purge embargo).

forecast_horizon.semantics: Forecast covers (t, t + horizon] where t = observation window_end. It is not a label for the observation window.

attack_type_taxonomy.rule: Return a canonical label when the model is trained for it; otherwise the family. BENIGN when risk_score < 20. UNKNOWN when is_ood is true.

missing_data_policy.no_flows_reject: A window with flow_count = 0 is not sent to the model; the backend stores window_features.is_complete = false.
missing_data_policy.zero_if_denominator_zero: Ratios and averages whose denominator is 0 are 0.0.
missing_data_policy.zero_if_no_previous_window: delta_* features are 0.0 for the first window of a traffic source.
missing_data_policy.one_if_no_history: packet_burst_score and syn_burst_score are 1.0 until three prior windows exist.
missing_data_policy.always_defined: Counts and sums are always computable for a non-empty window.
missing_data_policy.nan_or_inf: Any NaN/inf/missing feature after the rules above => INVALID_FEATURES; the request is rejected, no imputation, no fallback.
missing_data_policy.imputation: No mean/median imputation in v1. Revisit only with training-set statistics stored in model_versions.metrics_json.

http_equivalent.note: Same request/response bodies. Reserved for the strong version when inference moves to its own container; not exposed in the MVP.

inference_interface.model_dependencies: The fallback is pure Python. The trained model adds xgboost (and optionally shap) to backend/requirements.txt when it ships.

low_confidence.effect: is_uncertain = true; explanation summary is prefixed 'Uncertain forecast.'; alerts are still created from risk_score but severity is capped at high.

out_of_distribution.rule: at least 3 features with |z-score| > 6.0 against the training statistics in model_versions.metrics_json
out_of_distribution.effect: is_ood = true; predicted_attack_type = UNKNOWN; confidence_score <= 0.3; summary 'Pattern unseen, investigate manually.'

invalid_input.effect: InferenceError; backend returns 422 to callers, writes an audit event, stores no prediction, does not fall back.

model_failure.effect: Backend calls the rule-based fallback; response has is_fallback = true, fallback_reason = code, model_version = rule-fallback-v1.0.0; predictions.is_fallback = true.

error_codes.FEATURE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: feature_schema_version differs from the version the model was trained on; fail closed, audit, no fallback.
error_codes.INVALID_FEATURES: A feature is missing, non-numeric, NaN/inf, or outside its contract bounds; fail closed, no fallback.
error_codes.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: No active model artifact could be loaded; the backend uses the rule-based fallback.
error_codes.INFERENCE_TIMEOUT: The model did not answer within INFERENCE_TIMEOUT_SEC; the backend uses the rule-based fallback.
error_codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected exception inside the model; the backend uses the rule-based fallback and logs the trace.
